brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Tunisia experienced a summer of shortages. [1]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR TUNISIA
The summer of shortages may be linked to Tunisia's net energy import dependency of 0%, as domestic energy supply could not prevent the shortages. [1][E3]

KEY RISKS
Tunisia is linked to 8 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, posing a risk of financial and trade restrictions. [E2]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Tunisia, "Will Tunisia recognize Israel by December 31?", priced Yes at 6% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E4]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the Polymarket question "Will Tunisia recognize Israel by December 31?" remains unresolved. [E4]
